drawings.description: à droite, deux croquis : $T$, deux droites qui se coupent, portant les points $a$ et $b$, $T' = \{a, b\}$ ; et $\widetilde{T}$, les deux droites séparées, portant l'une $\{a\}$, l'autre $\{b\}$
drawings.kind: two crossing lines vs two separate lines
drawings.notes: Left: T, a brace over two lines that cross, carrying the points a and b; T' = {a, b} beside a brace. Right: T-tilde, a brace over two separate lines, one carrying {a}, the other {b}.

drawings.description: sous la formule, un croquis du terme $E_{2}$ : trois lignes horizontales, la plus haute marquée « 2 », fermées à droite par un trait vertical marqué « $N$ » ; des points sur les lignes, et deux flèches obliques $d_{2}$ descendant de la ligne 2 vers la ligne 1, puis de la ligne 1 vers la ligne 0, vers la droite
drawings.kind: sketch of the E_2 term: three rows with d_2 arrows
drawings.notes: Three horizontal lines, the top one marked 2, closed on the left by a vertical stroke and on the right by a vertical stroke; points on the lines and two oblique arrows d_2 going down to the right, from row 2 to row 1 and from row 1 to row 0. The "N" at the right stroke is not visible on the crop; it is placed after the transcription. The labels d_2 are not written beside the arrows on the page.

drawings.description: diagramme dessiné dans la marge inférieure gauche, en face des lignes sur la composition
drawings.kind: commutative diagram X, X', X'' with pi, f, g
drawings.notes: The diagram of the transcription in the lower left margin: X -pi- X, X' -pi'- X', X'' -pi''- X'', vertical arrows f and g. The horizontal pi strokes have no visible heads on the page.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, un premier dessin : $P \xrightarrow{u} Q$ avec une flèche $v$ en retour tracée au-dessus, et $P \to P' \simeq Q' \to Q$ ; en dessous, un second schéma plus confus où figurent $P' + P''$, $Q' + Q''$ et une flèche épaisse $P' \to Q'$, qui ne se laisse pas redessiner sûrement
drawings.kind: P -> Q with a return arrow v; second confused scheme
drawings.notes: Redrawn on tight crops. First drawing: P -u-> Q (thick arrow; Q is overwritten several times and drawn once), the return arrow v drawn above from the Q side to the P side, a thick arrow P -> P' (down), P' = Q' (the sign is overwritten, read as simeq after the transcription), a thick arrow Q' -> Q (up). Second, confused scheme: P' + P'' at the upper left, Q' + ... at the upper right (the Q'' of the transcription is cut by the margin of the crop and of the sheet, only Q' + is drawn), P' and Q' below; the thick arrows P' -> P'+P'' (up-left), a thick arrow from the left down to P', Q' -> P' (leftwards above), P' -> Q' (rightwards below, doubled and overwritten in the original, drawn once), Q' -> Q'+Q'' (up), a thin pencil arrow from Q'+Q'' down towards the arrow Q' -> P', and a broken thin arrow from P' up-left. Still differs: the directions in the second scheme are a reading (the transcription says it cannot be redrawn surely), the overwritings and a faint vertical stroke above the arrow Q' -> P' are left out.
